correctness.rationale: The proof identifies the convolution operator with a sum of two second-order augmentation generators in an exact truncated polynomial ring. Distinct minimal bidegrees preclude term cancellation; Lucas no-carry gives exact survival. For odd p the maximum exponent equals the sum of two degree caps and is attained carry-free, and its unique terminal term becomes the full group sum with computed sign; for p=2 bit-length bounds give the smaller clock. Boundaries and quantifiers include all prime \(p\) and integers \(a\ge b\ge1\); independent direct cell-stencil checking passes 19 varied examples. Finite diagnostics are not substituted for the proof.
